blocks.text: Merz Aesthetics, the world’s largest dedicated medical aesthetics business, honored the Philippines’ leading aesthetic doctors and clinics at the Tala Awards 2026, held at the Grand Ballroom of Solaire Resort Parañaque. Anchored on the theme “Confidence Without Limits,” the annual celebration recognized the visionaries whose expertise, artistry, and commitment continue to shape the future of medical aesthetics and P-Beauty in the Philippines. Bringing together nearly 500 distinguished guests, the event celebrated achievement, innovation, partnership, and legacy.
